description: Brazil integrated transport planning open data provides Brazilian PNL 2050 transport corridor GeoPackages and origin-destination matrices, including road, waterway, rail and intermodal corridors. The provider is INFRA SA. Geographical and temporal coverage: National Brazilian planning data include a 2023 base scenario and 2050 targets. The page states 31 priority corridors, 11 project-bank corridors and 46 OD macroproducts. The linked provider page supplies the access route and documentation; the resource payload was not retrieved. The licence is not stated in inspected metadata. A price for reuse is not established; consult the provider. Caveats: The page describes an incomplete progressive release; do not imply the entire updated input database is already available. For simulation, the documented contents can support transport network modelling and capacity planning. This use is an interpretation of the metadata, not a tested integration. No directly related existing catalogue record was established.
